belt_ranks_slug_required_when_public.name: belt_ranks_slug_required_when_public
belt_ranks_slug_required_when_public.value: NOT "belt_ranks"."publicly_visible" OR ("belt_ranks"."slug" IS NOT NULL AND "belt_ranks"."slug" <> '')

rank_history_source_event_consistency.name: rank_history_source_event_consistency
rank_history_source_event_consistency.value:
("rank_history"."source" = 'event' AND "rank_history"."event_id" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("rank_history"."source" = 'external' AND "rank_history"."event_id" IS NULL)

rank_history_verified_triple_consistency.name: rank_history_verified_triple_consistency
rank_history_verified_triple_consistency.value:
("rank_history"."verified" = false AND "rank_history"."verified_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "rank_history"."verified_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("rank_history"."verified" = true AND "rank_history"."verified_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "rank_history"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)

rank_requirement_age_group_has_bound.name: rank_requirement_age_group_has_bound
rank_requirement_age_group_has_bound.value: "rank_requirement_age_group"."age_from" IS NOT NULL OR "rank_requirement_age_group"."age_to" IS NOT NULL

rank_requirement_age_group_ordered.name: rank_requirement_age_group_ordered
rank_requirement_age_group_ordered.value: "rank_requirement_age_group"."age_from" IS NULL OR "rank_requirement_age_group"."age_to" IS NULL OR "rank_requirement_age_group"."age_from" <= "rank_requirement_age_group"."age_to"
